nodes.label: image transparency
nodes.rationale: the checkerboard beneath the brush resembles the conventional transparency indicator used by image editors; this meaning is inferred from the artwork.

nodes.label: Bitstream Vera license
nodes.rationale: font redistribution retains notices; modified fonts must avoid the protected Bitstream and Vera names

nodes.label: MIT license
nodes.rationale: copies retain the copyright and permission notice

nodes.label: effect preview jobs
nodes.rationale: worker threads process immutable snapshots; cancelling discards late results and accepting creates one edit

nodes.label: history and savepoints
nodes.rationale: gesture snapshots group edits, avoid empty history entries, and distinguish saved image content from selection-only changes

nodes.label: .opaint project format
nodes.rationale: a versioned header, bounded json metadata, and gzip layer pixels preserve document content without serializing session history

nodes.label: raster model
nodes.rationale: display-independent rgba8 layers and coverage masks permit engine tests without a window server

nodes.label: platform settings storage
nodes.rationale: recent files use the platform configuration directory and do not contain document contents

nodes.label: reference acceptance scenarios
nodes.rationale: matching reference scenarios are required before changing comparison results from not compared

nodes.label: local checks and 52 tests
nodes.rationale: the 2026-10-30 record verifies openpaint invariants and local compilation without establishing reference equivalence

nodes.label: paint.net 5.1.12 installer
nodes.rationale: the supplied SetupSfx executable embeds the application archive and is distinct from the editor executable

nodes.label: managed paintdotnet.dll
nodes.rationale: the x86-64 assembly contains CIL and ReadyToRun code and targets .NET 9

nodes.label: PDN3 serialization
nodes.rationale: static data-assembly calls identify XML, BinaryFormatter, DeferredFormatter, and gzip paths; interoperable fixtures and bounded parsing remain necessary

nodes.label: REA static evidence
nodes.rationale: portable managed inspections establish metadata and call anchors; main-assembly member inspection exceeded the metadata budget

nodes.label: resource-supported feature inventory
nodes.rationale: 1626 English resource entries identify tool names, modes, modifiers, effects, and parameters without proving runtime reachability

nodes.label: release artifact verification
nodes.rationale: version, architecture, expected package inventory, nonempty files, and SHA256SUMS are checked before public release

nodes.label: locked dependency license collector
nodes.rationale: offline Cargo.lock metadata selects actual dependency notices and records missing standalone license texts

nodes.label: linux deb rpm and AppImage
nodes.rationale: binary inspection determines the glibc dependency; AppImage bundles x11 libraries while relying on host glibc and graphics drivers

nodes.label: local deb validation
nodes.rationale: the locally built deb was extracted and its executable passed help and version checks; other package formats were not built locally

nodes.label: macos arm64 and x86_64 disk images
nodes.norm_label: macos arm64 and x86_64 disk images

nodes.label: optional signing and notarization
nodes.rationale: incomplete signing configuration fails explicitly and temporary signing material is removed

nodes.label: tag-triggered release workflow
nodes.rationale: publication follows successful checks and all package jobs; published releases are not replaced by reruns

nodes.label: windows installer and portable zip
nodes.rationale: x86-64 packages use the static msvc runtime and the installer registers an available .opaint handler without replacing defaults

nodes.label: complete reference payload
nodes.rationale: full extraction includes hostfxr.dll, hostpolicy.dll, and coreclr.dll missing from the earlier selected extraction; the editor assembly hash matches

nodes.label: unexecuted functional checks
nodes.rationale: no window, menu, editing operation, saved output, or .pdn fixture was observed; successful startup is needed before matched functional scenarios

nodes.label: isolated reference launch attempts
nodes.rationale: the installer and extracted editor were attempted with WINEARCH=win64 and a workspace-specific WINEPREFIX, bounded execution and retained logs

nodes.label: wine64 10.0
nodes.rationale: the installed 64-bit loader reports its version successfully; the default 32-bit launcher exits with SIGSYS, whose cause remains untraced

nodes.label: image codecs
nodes.rationale: png, bmp, tga, ico, and pnm support opening and saving; webp and dds are import only; several reference codecs remain unimplemented

nodes.label: macroquad
nodes.rationale: provides the native window, input, and rendering

nodes.label: openpaint
nodes.rationale: an independent native rust raster editor using paint.net 5.1.12 as a behavioral reference; complete parity is not established

nodes.label: platform dialog and clipboard helpers
nodes.rationale: native desktop helpers are optional because in-app path input and internal image clipboard fallbacks remain available

nodes.label: official visual and shortcut documentation
nodes.rationale: older official documentation supplements layout and shortcut evidence but does not measure the supplied executable

nodes.label: atomic file saves
nodes.rationale: temporary siblings are flushed and synced before rename so failed saves preserve the existing destination

nodes.label: distribution boundary
nodes.rationale: packages explicitly select application files and license notices rather than archiving the workspace or reference artifacts

nodes.label: runtime comparison gap
nodes.rationale: the documented verification record contains no matching reference execution or interactive gui acceptance

nodes.label: native host validation gap
nodes.rationale: workflow definitions and local builds do not prove hosted ci, installation, signing, notarization, or gui execution on each platform

nodes.label: unavailable desktop display
nodes.rationale: xdpyinfo cannot open :0, the configured authorization file is absent, and no Xvfb or Xephyr is available

nodes.label: wineserver initialization failure
nodes.rationale: all launch attempts exited before application startup because /run/user/1000/wine could not be created on the read-only filesystem; a private XDG_RUNTIME_DIR did not change the selected location

nodes.label: reference artifact exclusion
nodes.rationale: the paint.net installer is an investigation artifact and is excluded from application distributions
